evidence.FACTS: Removed unsourced and policy-like statements: 'dans les flottes de location elle représente l'offre la plus large', 'la trail de location, souvent une 250', 'tarif logiquement supérieur', 'se construit sur devis', 'Hanoi–Cao Bang de l'ordre de trois cents kilomètres', rental 'agence sérieuse', 'flottes concentrées à Hanoï'. No rate for any model; no fleet or stock claim; availability and model/cylindrée only as questions to the shop. Added sourced context: Cao Bằng province unchanged (Tuổi Trẻ, retrieved per digest); Bản Giốc about 80-85 km from Cao Bằng city (Lonely Planet seen in search result per digest and another guide snippet), road paved but narrow in places, livestock, fuel at Quảng Uyên about 40 km (one guide snippet, to confirm on site), Mã Phục pass 'lacets jugés dangereux par certains' (search snippet); Non Nước Cao Bằng UNESCO Global Geopark recognised 2018 (vietnamnet.vn and VnExpress, seen in search result). Licence: A1 up to 125 cm3/11 kW, A above, IDP of a 1968 Vienna Convention state (law 36/2024 art. 57, E-legal digest), 'Vérifié le 30 octobre 2026', and that the cylindrée of a given trail must be checked. Headlight art. 20, expressway art. 25(3). Generic category comparison (height, weight, ground clearance) is stated as general, with model-specific figures left to the shop. Shop: address/phone per SEO-FACTS; all policies as questions. Review flags are the licence statements and the question list.
